Bulk Chai Masala Powder — Chai Masala Powder for Wholesale and Export

Tradenest Naturals is a trusted bulk chai masala powder supplier India businesses can contact for consistent spice blends, flexible packing, and export support. Our chai masala powder combines selected warming spices for an aromatic, balanced, and convenient tea preparation. We supply wholesale chai masala powder to beverage companies, cafés, restaurants, hotels, distributors, private label brands, and food manufacturers. As an experienced chai masala powder exporter, we support standard and customized requirements. Buyers can order chai masala powder in bulk for foodservice, retail packing, instant beverage mixes, and contract manufacturing. Our team also develops customer-specific recipes, spice strengths, pack sizes, and label formats. Request a sample, technical discussion, or chai masala powder wholesale price from Tradenest Naturals. Share your target market, required quantity, packaging format, and specification. We will review the requirement and provide a practical quotation.

Product Overview

Chai Masala Powder is a finely milled spice blend designed for Indian-style milk tea and spiced tea beverages. The blend typically features ginger, cardamom, cinnamon, clove, black pepper, and other complementary spices. The final recipe can change according to regional taste, application, and customer preference. Our standard profile delivers a warm aroma, gentle sweetness from natural spices, and a balanced heat. However, we can adjust the flavor for mild, medium, or strong chai applications. We can also develop blends with higher cardamom, ginger, pepper, or cinnamon notes.
  • Suitable for hot milk tea and black tea.
  • Designed for commercial kitchens and beverage production.
  • Available for retail, foodservice, and industrial use.
  • Produced with controlled grinding, blending, and sieving.
  • Supported by batch identification and product documentation.

Ingredients and Formulation

The ingredient statement for the standard blend includes ginger, cardamom, cinnamon, clove, and black pepper. The exact formulation may vary by approved customer specification. We can also discuss additions such as fennel, nutmeg, star anise, or natural sweet spice notes. We use food-grade spice ingredients selected for aroma, color, and flavor performance. The formulation contains no unnecessary filler in the standard product. If a buyer requires a specific allergen declaration, dietary statement, or restricted-ingredient profile, our technical team reviews the requirement before production. Chai masala powder manufacturer requirements often differ by market. Therefore, Tradenest Naturals confirms the recipe, particle size, packaging, and documentation before starting a commercial batch. This approach helps reduce variation between repeat orders.

Manufacturing and Processing

Our processing method includes raw material inspection, cleaning, controlled grinding, blending, and sieving. First, we assess incoming spices for appearance, aroma, and general quality. Next, we grind ingredients to the agreed particle size. We then blend the components according to the approved formulation. After blending, we sieve the powder to improve uniformity and remove oversized particles. We control handling conditions to reduce exposure to moisture, foreign matter, and cross-contamination risks. Finally, we pack the finished product in suitable food-grade packaging and assign batch details for traceability. For private label and OEM projects, we can support recipe development, label coordination, pack selection, and production planning. Customers may request a standard product or a custom chai masala powder supplier solution for a defined market.

Typical Technical Specifications

The following values represent typical commercial specifications. Final specifications depend on the agreed formulation and destination-market requirements. We confirm the applicable product specification before order approval.
  • Mesh size: Typically 60 to 80 mesh; 80 to 100 mesh available on request.
  • Moisture content: Typically not more than 8%.
  • Purity: Typically 99% minimum, excluding permitted formulation ingredients.
  • Appearance: Fine, free-flowing brown to reddish-brown spice powder.
  • Flavor: Warm, aromatic, spicy, and balanced.
  • Foreign matter: Not intentionally added; controlled through inspection and sieving.
  • Packaging: Food-grade, moisture-resistant, and tamper-evident formats.
Buyers should request a current specification sheet when they need exact limits for moisture, microbiology, heavy metals, pesticides, allergens, or other parameters. Testing and documentation can be discussed according to the destination country and customer quality plan.

Quality and Compliance Support

Tradenest Naturals follows documented food safety practices, batch traceability, raw material inspection, moisture control, and quality checks. We do not claim certifications that have not been confirmed for a specific facility or product. Therefore, customers should request the current certification and compliance documents during quotation review. Available documentation may depend on the order, destination, and customer requirement. We can discuss product specifications, certificate of analysis requirements, allergen information, ingredient declarations, packing details, and export documents. In addition, customer audits and third-party testing can be reviewed where commercially practical. Importers should confirm local requirements before placing an order. These requirements may include labeling language, permitted ingredients, pesticide limits, microbiological criteria, or religious and dietary declarations. Our export team coordinates agreed documentation before dispatch.

Applications

Chai masala powder supports a wide range of beverage and food applications. It adds a recognizable spiced-tea character without requiring separate spice handling in every serving. As a result, commercial users can improve preparation speed and recipe consistency.
  • Masala chai served in cafés, restaurants, hotels, and QSR outlets.
  • Instant chai and spiced tea premixes.
  • Milk tea, black tea, and iced tea formulations.
  • Tea bags, sachets, and single-serve beverage kits.
  • Ready-to-drink tea and beverage concentrate development.
  • Bakery, dessert, confectionery, and seasonal flavor applications.
  • Private label retail spice and beverage products.
  • Cloud kitchen and catering beverage service.

Buyer Value

Bulk purchasing can help professional buyers control ingredient costs and reduce repeated procurement work. Moreover, a consistent blend supports the same taste across locations, production runs, and retail packs. The powder format also saves preparation time compared with measuring several whole spices.
  • Consistent flavor for repeat commercial recipes.
  • Efficient handling for high-volume beverage preparation.
  • Long shelf life when stored in sealed, dry conditions.
  • Flexible pack sizes for sampling, foodservice, and wholesale use.
  • Custom recipe support for regional and private label markets.
  • Export-ready packing and documentation coordination.

Packaging and Shelf Life

We offer 100 g, 250 g, 500 g, 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg, and 25 kg formats. Bulk bags and custom export packing can support larger commercial requirements. Available formats include stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers, laminated inner bags, and private label packs. We use food-grade, moisture-resistant packaging selected for the order size and transport method. Each approved pack can include product name, ingredient statement, net weight, batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, storage instructions, and other required details. The typical shelf life is 12 months from manufacture when the product remains unopened and stored correctly. Some formulations may support a different shelf life after validation. Buyers should keep the powder in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, heat, humidity, and strong odors. Close the pack after every use.

MOQ, Lead Time, and Samples

What is the minimum order quantity for bulk chai masala powder supplier India buyers? Our typical MOQ for standard bulk chai masala powder is 25 kg. However, the final MOQ depends on the formulation, pack type, artwork, and order schedule. Private label or customized OEM projects may require a higher quantity. Standard production usually requires approximately 7 to 15 working days after formulation approval, packaging confirmation, and advance payment. Custom blends, printed packaging, testing, or export documentation may extend the timeline. We confirm the lead time in the commercial quotation. To request a sample or quote, send the required quantity, target application, preferred mesh, packaging size, destination country, and label needs. We can then assess the requirement and share availability, sample options, estimated chai masala powder wholesale price, and documentation details.
